operation_scope: Offline FFU inspection, hash-table verification, partition extraction and filesystem reads

checks.browser_inspection: Headless Microsoft Edge running the real Rust WASM worker: platform and all 28 partitions matched native inspection

extraction.comparison: Matched scripts/reference-ffu-check.py, an independent Python translation of the pinned upstream FFU.cs mapping algorithm; upstream C# was not executed
extraction.directory_read: EFI contains boot, Microsoft and Nokia

mainos.comparison: Matched the independently translated upstream FFU mapping calculation

extracted_kernel.reference: SHA-1 matches an original target hash in the unchanged upstream 2.9.2 patch catalog

limitations: One local image: EFIESP and MainOS reconstruction, FAT16 directory reads, and NTFS directory/kernel reads. Installed phone firmware is 3051.50009.1451.1003, different from the image filename. Does not establish flash, unlock, restore, NTFS writes, compressed/encrypted NTFS streams or wider firmware support.
privacy_and_redistribution: Only metadata and hashes are published. Original firmware, extracted proprietary bytes and local personal paths are excluded.
